messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] missing functions
parts:
I really need to add a test for all of the functions
we declare. I was going to do that after writing the
full doc, which is next on my to-do list.

Here's how those two are added:

add("if_else",DOUBLE_T,INT_T,DOUBLE_T,DOUBLE_T);
add_binary("binomial_coefficient_log");

For add(), the first argument is the return type
and the remaining arguments are the argument types
in order.

The function add_binary is just shorthand for

add(s,DOUBLE_T,DOUBLE_T,DOUBLE_T)

I'm thinking we're probably gonig to want an if_else
defined with a DOUBLE_T first arg as well as an INT_T.

- Bob
